_readme: Real photography. 'cdn' = images.unsplash.com photo id; 'id' = unsplash.com/photos/<id> short id; 'file' = a local path (relative to the project) if you want to supply your own. Run `npm run photos` to download at 3840px and build the responsive set into public/images/photos/. Unsplash License: free for commercial use, attribution optional.
